翻译 种花小医杂家赵FARINOSA (Lindley) Britton & Rose, 1903曾用名：
Echeveria farinosa Lindley (1849) / Cotyledon farinosa (Lindley) Baker (1869)
Echeveria farinulenta Lemaire (1864)
Dudleya compacta Rose (1903) / Cotyledon compacta (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria compacta (Rose) A. Berger (1930)
Dudleya eastwoodiae Rose (1903) / Cotyledon eastwoodiae (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria eastwoodiae (Rose) A. Berger (1930)
Dudleya septentrionalis Rose (1903) / Cotyledon septentrionalis (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria septentrionalis (Rose) A. Berger (1930)Subgenus Dudleya ——仙女杯亚属形态描述（根据 IHSP，2003）：茎干：修长，直径约1 - 3厘米。植株：单个莲座的直径约有4 到10厘米，约有15 - 30片叶。常常呈多分枝群生生长。叶片：呈长卵圆形，叶片前端尖锐。叶片的中部常有一条明显的脊线，脊线在叶片正面和背面都存在。叶片长约2.5 -6厘米，宽约1 - 2.5厘米。叶片分两种形态：被厚粉的、或完全无粉呈现出绿色
【根据这种区别有资料把farinosa分为两种 即Dudleya farinosa（带粉个体）和Dudleya farinosa "green form"（不带粉个体）】。花序：花葶长约10 - 35厘米，花在花序上分布密集，在顶端集中开花。花序直径4 到8厘米，常独生。有时单个花序上会产生三到五个稍细的（1 - 3.5厘米）蝎尾形分支。分支后每个花序3 - 11朵花，单花的花梗长1 - 3（-5）毫米。花：花萼直径5 ​​- 8毫米，单个萼片三角状卵形，尖锐，3 - 7毫米长。花瓣倒披针形，花瓣是互相分离的（仙女杯亚属的特征哦~），花瓣长10 - 14毫米，宽3 - 5毫米，淡黄色，花管（原文"tube"不会翻译了…）长1 - 2毫米，花瓣尖端尖锐，逐渐过渡到钝圆。细胞学检查：染色体数= 17常常与D. pulverulenta（仙女杯"雪山"）形成自然杂交后代。英文版原文摘录如下，欢迎勘误：Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :Stems often elongate, 1 – 3 cm in diameter.Rosettes 4 – 10 cm in diameter, with 15 – 30 leaves, mostly much-branched.Leaves oblong-ovate, apically acute, usually with a clear keel ± in the middle and smaller keels on either side, 2.5 – 6 x 1 – 2.5 cm, strongly farinose or green.Inflorescences : Scape 10 – 35 cm, inflorescences usually rather dense, flat-topped, 4 – 8 cm in diameter, with 3 – 5 not or 1x branched scorpioid branches, these 1 – 3.5 cm, with 3 – 11 flowers, pedicels 1 – 3 (-5) mm.Flowers : Calyx 5 – 8 mm, sepals triangular-ovate, acute, 3 – 7 mm, petals oblanceolate, mostly not touching each other laterally, 10 – 14 x 3 – 5 mm, pale yellow, tube 1 – 2 mm, lobes apically sometimes ± spreading, acute to obtuse.Cytology : n = 17Forms natural hybrids with D. pulverulenta.
